lensXraySay: Lenzi ya X-ray. Lozani chilichonse kuti muwone momwe chinapangidwira.
lensMakersSay: Lenzi ya opanga. Lozani chilichonse kuti muwone amene anachipanga.
lensFlagSay: Lenzi ya chizindikiro. Sankhani chigawo chomwe mukufuna kunena kapena kukhumba.
lensesOffSay: Malenzi azimitsidwa. Dongosolo limagwira ntchito mwachizolowezi; m'mbali zikuwonetsa kuti magalasi akadali oyaka.
followingSay: Kutsatira {name}: chilichonse chomwe anapanga chalembedwa mzere. Dinani chigawo chilichonse kuti muwone ena omwe anachipanga.
putOnSay: Mukuwona zomwe Future Traveler akuwona. Lozani chilichonse kuti muwone momwe chinapangidwira.
ownerNative: Muyezo wa HTML: W3C ndi msakatuli
ownerOutside: Osati kuchokera ku HAX; amene anachipanga sakudziwika pano
nothingOnScreen: Palibe chomwe anapanga chili pa sikirini iyi pakali pano. Tsegulani chosinthira kapena tsamba lina ndipo zigawo zawo zidzawala.
shotFailedSay: Chithunzi cha sikirini sichinathe kupangidwa pano, choncho nkhaniyo ili ndi chithunzi cha X-ray m'malo mwake.
shotReadySay: Chithunzi cha sikirini chakonzeka. Chimapita ku clipboard yanu mukatsegula nkhani, kotero mungachimate.
shotBlockedSay: Msakatuli wanu waletsa kukopera chithunzi. Dinani kumanja pa chithunzi cha sikirini ndipo sankhani Koperani chithunzi, kenako chimateni mu nkhani.
shotCopiedSay: Chithunzi cha sikirini chakoperedwa. Mu nkhani, dinani pamene pakuti mumate, kenako dinani Ctrl+V (Cmd+V pa Mac).
copyBlockedSay: Kukopera kwaletsedwa ndi msakatuli. Sankhani zolembazo m'malo mwake.
flaggedSay: {tag} yalembedwa chizindikiro. Fotokozani zomwe munawona kapena zomwe mukufuna kuti zichite.
notRegistered: Chigawo ichi sichili mu kaundula wa HAX, choncho mbiri yake sikudziwika pano.
agentCommits: Ma commit ena {commits} opangidwa ndi othandizira a khodi, otsogozedwa ndi anthu omwe ali pamwambawa.
shotFailedCaption: Chithunzi cha X-ray, {w} x {h} px. Chithunzi cha sikirini sichinathe kupangidwa pano.
shotAltWhole: Chithunzi cha sikirini ndi {tag} chozunguliridwa mzere
shotCaption: {w} x {h} px PNG, {kb} KB. Ngati kukopera kwaletsedwa, dinani kumanja pa chithunzi ndipo sankhani Koperani chithunzi.
copyShotOpenIssue: Koperani chithunzi cha sikirini ndipo tsegulani nkhani
lensTranslateSay: Lenzi yomasulira. Mawu aliwonse ozunguliridwa ndi mzere angathe kukonzedwa. Dinani amodzi.
txPickLangHint: HAX imasinthira ku chilankhulocho, kuti muwone mawu omwe anthu amawaona kwenikweni. Mungasinthe nthawi iliyonse.
txLinkCopied: Ulalo wakopedwa. Aliyense woutsegula adzapeza tsamba ili mu {lang} ndi lenzi yomasulira itayatsidwa.
txKeep: Siyani {tokens} monga momwe zalembedwera: HAX imaika mtengo pamenepo.
txEmpty: Palibe pakadali pano. Dinani mawu aliwonse ozunguliridwa kuti muyambe.
txSendHint: Imatsegula lipoti lokonzeka kale. Lowani mu GitHub ndipo dinani Create. Simukuyenera kusintha kalikonse.
txCopied: Zakopedwa. Zimatani mu imelo kapena macheza kwa gulu la HAX.
txSameAsNow: Mawu anu ali chimodzimodzi ndi apano.
txLookingAt: {en}, tsopano {now}. Dinani Enter kuti mupereke mawu abwino.
noChecksFound: Mayeso a pawokha sanapeze kalikonse pano. Fotokozani chomwe chakulepheretsani.
checkContrast: Kusiyana kwa mitundu ya zolemba ndi kochepa kwambiri ({ratio})
alreadyReported: Zanenedwa kale? Yang'anani kaye, ndipo perekani +1 pamenepo m'malo mwake.
replayHelp: Kubwereza kumalola wosamalira kutsegula izi pa tsamba loyesera ndi kuona vutolo. Mafayilo a tsamba lanu amasinthidwa ndi zoimira.
replayTooBig: Kubwereza uku ndi kwakukulu kwambiri kwa ulalo. Kutsitseni ndipo kokerani fayilo mu vutolo.
githubAccount: Malipoti amapita ku GitHub; mukufunika akaunti ya GitHub.
